description: This file defines React components for context menu options in a note-taking application, including handling categories and notes with various actions like delete, rename, favorite, and download.

classes.name: ContextMenuOptions
classes.description: Main React component that renders different context menu options based on item type (category or note).

classes.name: CategoryOptions
classes.description: Component providing options for category items, such as rename and delete.

classes.name: NotesOptions
classes.description: Component providing options for note items, including delete, favorite, trash, download, and copy reference.

methods.name: removeCategoryHandler
methods.description: Deletes a category and removes it from notes, then resets folder view.

methods.name: downloadNotesHandler
methods.description: Downloads selected notes or the clicked note.

methods.name: favoriteNoteHandler
methods.description: Toggles favorite status for a note.

methods.name: copyLinkedNoteMarkdownHandler
methods.description: Copies a note reference in markdown format to clipboard.
